boundsDescription: 3D cylindrical storage tank with transparent wall, dynamically scaled water body, inlet/outlet/overflow pipes and deterministic directional tracers. The shell is an illustrative storage vessel; water fill fraction maps exact modeled level/maxLevel while numerical tankArea governs storage volume.

presentation.visualScaleNote: Tank shell plan geometry is illustrative; vertical fill fraction follows level/maxLevel. Numerical level, area and volume come only from the mass-balance model.
